findings.title: Validate envelope length before slicing the shared-memory payload
findings.evidence: env.data[..env.len] precedes unpack validation. IpcEnvelope has public len: usize and data: [u8; 8192] (bft_iceoryx2.rs:78-81); bindings.rs:211-214 exposes this writer through start_writer_daemon.
findings.trigger: An IPC publisher submits an IpcEnvelope with len > 8192.
findings.impact: The writer thread panics before rejecting malformed input, stopping ingestion until restarted. No claim of memory unsafety is made.

findings.title: Reject invalid payload hash text instead of signing a zero digest
findings.evidence: payload_hash starts as [0;32]; decoding only runs for length 64 and successful hex decode, but BftMessage::sign is unconditional at line 111. bindings.rs:203-205 forwards arbitrary Python hash strings.
findings.trigger: publish_node is called with a malformed or wrong-length hexadecimal digest.
findings.impact: The call returns success and publishes a valid signature over a different all-zero digest, silently losing payload identity.

findings.title: Propagate failed and missing maintenance phases to the global verdict
findings.evidence: Only phase_4 FAIL and phase_1 isolation FAIL set has_critical_failure. phase_2/3/5 failures become WARN; missing gates initialize True at 157-175. Lines 248-251 remove an existing alert when those two critical checks pass; line 318 returns zero.
findings.trigger: Log preservation or vault consolidation fails, synchronization fails, or required gate scripts are absent.
findings.impact: The scheduled command can report HEALTHY_OPTIMAL, clear an outstanding alert and exit successfully despite failed or unexecuted maintenance obligations.

findings.title: Correct the attojoule scaling of the Landauer constants
findings.evidence: The file states 2.87e-21 J/bit at lines 10-14 and names the unit aJ*1000, but assigns 2870 and total 1102080 at 36/44. Since 1 aJ=1e-18 J, 2.87e-21 J is 0.00287 aJ, or 2.87 aJ*1000, not 2870. aphairesis_entropy_loss_aj_x1000 multiplies this constant at 121.
findings.trigger: A caller uses the exported aJ*1000 constants or aphairesis_entropy_loss_aj_x1000 according to their documented units.
findings.impact: Computed energy floors are overstated by approximately 1000x; compile-time assertions merely enforce the same erroneous scale. This is a numerical/unit finding, not an empirical energy measurement.

findings.title: Use a wider mask for the advertised eight-sample boundary
findings.evidence: The API advertises n<=8 at 41 and debug_asserts n<=8 at 45, but builds the mask with (1u8 << n)-1 at 63.
findings.trigger: cluster_and_compute_entropy is called with n=8, which its public contract admits.
findings.impact: Shifting an eight-bit integer by eight overflows; checked builds panic and unchecked execution cannot form the required 0xff domain mask, invalidating the advertised boundary.

findings.title: Make Channel Rack CC ranges disjoint
findings.evidence: Selection checks cc_num < chan_count before mute range 16 <= cc_num <16+chan_count and solo range 32 <= cc_num <32+chan_count.
findings.trigger: A project has 17 or more channels and receives channel-7 CC16 to mute channel0; with 33 channels CC32 is likewise consumed by selection.
findings.impact: Mute/solo commands select a different channel or mute an unintended channel instead of performing the requested operation.

findings.title: Give each render a private source-embedding file
findings.evidence: TEMP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH is the constant /tmp/c5_source_embeddings.npz at 103; every prepare call overwrites it at 735. Worker mode reloads that global path at 1177-1193 rather than a path tied to its parent render.
findings.trigger: Two face-swap processes overlap while one prepares identities and the other starts its workers.
findings.impact: Workers can load the other render's source and target identities, producing the wrong face replacements and mixing biometric data between jobs.

findings.title: Preserve audio offset when rendering a frame subrange
findings.evidence: The rendered video starts at range_start (969-983), while audio extraction at 950 reads the entire input and final mux at 1067-1075 uses that untrimmed audio without a seek or offset.
findings.trigger: A caller supplies --start-frame > 0 to render a subrange of a video with audio.
findings.impact: The output shows the chosen later frames paired with audio from the beginning, producing systematic audio/video desynchronization.

findings.title: Paste enhanced image patches when the ellipse mask is selected
findings.evidence: In process_image_pipeline the enhancer branch computes ready_512 at 840-861, but updates res only inside if bisenet_sess is not None at 864-882. The fallback paste is the else for enhancer at 883, not the mask condition.
findings.trigger: An image render uses --mask ellipse with an enabled enhancer (including defaults), or BiSeNet is unavailable.
findings.impact: The enhanced face is never pasted into res; the command saves the unchanged image and prints DONE. Video mode has an ellipse fallback at 512-519, but image mode lacks it.

findings.title: Scope the semantic-entropy correctness claim to supplied constraints
findings.evidence: ADR claims zero false negatives and 100% neutralization of systematic false beliefs. Its referenced module explicitly says supplied SAT does not establish external factual truth (semantic_entropy.rs:25-41) and evaluate accepts caller-supplied SolverOutcome (170-180). The assigned demo passes literal true/false at 194/201/208/215 instead of invoking a solver.
findings.trigger: A reader relies on the ADR as evidence that the implementation detects arbitrary factual falsehoods or that its benchmark measured SMT-backed detection.
findings.impact: Documentation overstates the implemented guarantee and can cause integrations to treat a constraint classification or synthetic fixture as factual verification. No effect-dispatch bypass is alleged.
